channel.title: Religion News Service - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Religion News Service (religionnews.com)

item.title: When Money Walks In, Does God Walk Out?
item.description: Success, influence, and staying spiritually grounded in rooms where money seems to matter most.

item.title: Photos of the Week: Iran war, Jesse Jackson memorial
item.description: This week’s photo selection includes the war in Iran, a memorial service for Jesse Jackson and more.

item.title: What to know about Iran’s Revolutionary Guard, a powerful force within the country’s theocracy
item.description: The force is again in the spotlight as Iran widens its attacks across the Middle East following the start of a U.S.-Israeli airstrike campaign that's already killed the country's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Man who rammed car into Chabad headquarters in NYC pleads not guilty to federal charge
item.description: Dan Sohail, 36, was previously arrested on state charges following the Jan. 28 incident, which damaged an entrance of the revered Jewish site, but did not cause any injuries.

item.title: Purim parties shift to bomb shelters as Israelis celebrate under Iran war threat
item.description: People of all ages wearing sequined suits, bunny ears, pirate costumes and peacock feathers streamed into a mall’s underground parking lot that also functions as a bomb shelter for the traditional reading of the Purim story followed by a live band with dancing.

item.title: The many stories behind Holi, Hinduism’s festival of colors
item.description: In all interpretations, Holi is seen as a festive day to end conflicts, forgive the past and start a new season.

item.title: To adopt AI or resist it? That’s not the question.
item.description: The more faithful response is neither rejection nor uncritical embrace. It is intentional formation.

item.title: Conservative Anglican leaders meet in Nigeria to elect a leader, fueling concerns of schism
item.description: Officials say the intention of the meetings is not to create a new communion but to reorder the current one.

item.title: Why some Muslims are mourning the death of Ayatollah Khamenei as others celebrate
item.description: The ayatollah’s killing on the first day of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran has divided Muslims, mostly along sectarian lines.

item.title: What Lent can teach us about attempting to make peace by force
item.description: The current military action against Iran is a clash of ethical impulses: the security of the country versus the kind of nation we are becoming.
